title: Matched junta sample
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P$ be a subset of $\\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $z$ assign a sign in $\{\pm1\}$ to each index in $P$. A matched junta sample is a pair consisting of a point $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$ and a sign, together with the condition that $x$ matches the assignment $z$ on $P$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite subset of the indices $0,\ldots,n-1$
$z$ assigns a sign to each index in $P$
